brief:
Hamas political bureau chief Khalil al-Hayya called for "urgent action" to repair Gaza's sewers and improve rainwater drainage, Middle East Eye reported. Heavy rains recently destroyed tens of thousands of tents across the territory, triggering the appeal.

The sewage and drainage infrastructure failures compound existing humanitarian challenges in Gaza, where the population faces severe shortages of basic services and sanitation infrastructure.
dek: Hamas calls for urgent repairs to Gaza’s sewage and drainage systems Hamas political bureau chief Khalil al-Hayya has called for “urgent action” to fix Gaza’s sewers and improve rainwater drainage after heavy rains destroyed tens of thousands of tents.
title: Hamas demands urgent repairs to Gaza sewage systems after rains
